summary: Audax Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly NAV per share as of April 30, 2026, which was $24.822 for common shares. The filing also reported aggregate NAV of $569.2M, portfolio fair value of $1,047.8M, and debt outstanding of $536.2M (debt-to-equity of 0.94x). This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure by a business development company (BDC), not a special situation. There is no transaction, no board action, no advisor, and no structural change. What to watch: None — this is a standard regulatory report with no event risk.
